basis: Editorial navigation from the cited warnings in each linked profile; not a measured risk ranking.

groups.title: Serious ingestion hazards
groups.description: Plants with serious poisoning warnings. Affected species and evidence strength differ; use the individual profile before drawing conclusions about a person or animal.

groups.title: Pets, paws and skin contact
groups.description: A route to awns, burs, sharp points and irritating plant contact, including poison-ivy oil carried on fur.

groups.title: Pasture, hay and livestock losses
groups.description: For landowners and animal keepers: forage poisoning and injury deserve their own review. Livestock findings are not pet exposure limits.

groups.title: Dry grass, tumbleweeds and fire concerns
groups.description: Read the profiles for the evidence about dry vegetation, tumbling plants and effects on land management.

groups.title: Persistent roots and habitat displacement
groups.description: Plants whose spread or persistence can make restoration and routine garden management difficult. Methods depend on the site and confirmed identity.

groups.title: Waterways and aquatic habitats
groups.description: Use the individual accounts to understand spread and identification before moving plants, water or equipment from an affected site.
